art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Briar is a pale adult young woman with short uneven white-lavender hair, striking pink-red eyes, pointed ears, and a distinctive curved wooden restraint frame around her shoulders. Preserve these identity anchors without distress, frightening spikes, or predatory expression. Dress her in a fully covering maroon tunic, opaque trousers, wrapped shoes, and a substantial dark cape, keeping natural adult comic proportions.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: pale lilac, burgundy, lilac pencil shadow, copper sunset; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
